shortlist: Acute Posterior Multifocal Placoid Pigment Epitheliopathy

selector.why: The presence of a positive Cerebrospinal fluid T pallidum particle agglutination assay and skin lesion histopathology demonstrating interface dermatitis with spirochetes, along with the clinical presentation, suggests an alternative diagnosis but the specific ocular findings such as corneal stromal haze and vitreous cell and haze obscuring retinal vascular details are more indicative of Toxoplasmosis among the given options.
